title: AUTONOMOUS HANDOVER - finalize 3EN002 + Pi-hole integration
description: One-time automation bootstrap. Starts the v3.10.1 native project orchestrator on the full five-chapter router/Pi-hole integration project. The project auto-approves safe reversible work, hides routine errors, self-repairs, validates and rolls back on final failure.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$root='C:/3EN-Agent';$base='https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/main/';$runner=$root+'/3en-agent-runner-v3.10.1.ps1';Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ($base+'3en-agent-runner-v3.10.1.ps1') -OutFile $runner;$tok=$null;$err=$null;[System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($runner,[ref]$tok,[ref]$err)|Out-Null;if(@($err).Count-ne0){throw 'runner validation failed'};$manifest=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base+'project-router-pihole-final.json');if([string]$manifest.projectId-ne'2026-09-09-router-pihole-final-v1'){throw 'project manifest mismatch'};if(@($manifest.chapters).Count-ne5){throw 'project chapter count invalid'};$existing=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-agent-runner-v3.10.1.ps1*project-router-pihole-final.json*'});if($existing.Count-eq0){$p=Start-Process powershell.exe -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-ExecutionPolicy','Bypass','-File',$runner,'-ProjectPath','project-router-pihole-final.json') -PassThru;Write-Host ('PROJECT_PID='+$p.Id)}else{Write-Host ('PROJECT_ALREADY_RUNNING_PID='+$existing[0].ProcessId)};Write-Host 'ROUTER_PIHOLE_PROJECT_LAUNCH=PASS'
test: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';Start-Sleep -Seconds 2;$running=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue|Where-Object{$_.CommandLine -and $_.CommandLine -like '*3en-agent-runner-v3.10.1.ps1*project-router-pihole-final.json*'});$state='C:/3EN-Agent/3en-project.state.json';$accepted=$false;if(Test-Path $state){try{$s=Get-Content $state -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json;if([string]$s.projectId-eq'2026-09-09-router-pihole-final-v1'){$accepted=$true}}catch{}};if($running.Count-eq0 -and -not $accepted){throw 'project orchestrator did not accept handover'};Write-Host 'ROUTER_PIHOLE_HANDOVER_TEST=PASS'
rollback: Write-Host 'Handover rollback is not required: bootstrap changes no router/Pi-hole configuration; project chapters own their backups and rollback.'
